blocking_question_resolutions.exact_issue: Approve whether this first set governs provider description records only, or must also specify runtime behavior. All candidates explicitly target description records; no runtime efficacy follows.
blocking_question_resolutions.resolution: Use a universal provider information/declaration baseline for an identified autonomous-system version and explicit operating scope. The obligated actor is the declarant/provider. Runtime outcomes and system authorization are excluded.
blocking_question_resolutions.alternatives_considered: A runtime safety standard would require unsupported control/evaluation criteria; unrestricted overview prose is not inspectable.

blocking_question_resolutions.exact_issue: Approve scope boundaries, dynamically discovered tools, permission exceptions and whether runtime denial behavior belongs in release 1.
blocking_question_resolutions.resolution: Inventory the available scoped functions, used dependencies, authorized permissions and their mechanism references at the declaration snapshot. Dynamic sets are represented by version-specific manifests/selectors; unknown completeness is declared unknown, never satisfied. Descriptions do not prove enforcement.
blocking_question_resolutions.alternatives_considered: Sampling only observed successful actions omits capability scope; requiring an unbounded supply-chain census exceeds the source obligations.

blocking_question_resolutions.exact_issue: Review minimum test methods, evidence accessibility, privacy, retention and whether evidence plans alone suffice. No completeness or conformance follows from evidence presence.
blocking_question_resolutions.resolution: Requirement 0014 requires a plan, not a passing execution result. The versioned declaration contract supplies exact requirement/evidence linkage and explicit applicability/assertion states; 0015 is deferred rather than duplicating that contract. Evidence presence remains NOT_EVALUATED.
blocking_question_resolutions.alternatives_considered: Automatic evidence scoring or independent-review claims lack a governed evaluator; public disclosure of private evidence is not required.

blocking_question_resolutions.exact_issue: OAS must identify its authorized adopter, decision procedure/quorum and approval record. None is established by repository code.
blocking_question_resolutions.resolution: Establish transparent FOUNDING GOVERNANCE: founding maintainer role, delegated author/reviewer roles, exact-snapshot acceptance/issuance record, separate final adoption and publisher actions, and a multi-party migration process. No person or board is invented. A real maintainer must still accept this exact snapshot before RC issuance. The procedural mechanism is closed, but role occupancy and exact-snapshot acceptance are still absent; Q10 remains blocking for issuance until that real record exists.
blocking_question_resolutions.alternatives_considered: External consensus is unsupported; agent self-appointment or treating a technical green check as institutional acceptance would manufacture authority.

blocking_question_resolutions.exact_issue: Review every ambiguous reporting label and approve migration disposition before canonical report adoption.
blocking_question_resolutions.resolution: Quarantine all seven labels without defensible equivalence. Quarantine is a terminal namespace-specific migration exclusion: no automatic canonical projection, ordinal mapping or normalization. Preserve the existing Human Oversight lexical alias to D06.
blocking_question_resolutions.alternatives_considered: Forced one-to-one or ordinal mapping changes meaning; unresolved live aliases would allow silent contamination.

blocking_question_resolutions.exact_issue: Decide whether these traceable description obligations constitute a useful complete first standard; no claim of complete autonomous-system governance is made.
blocking_question_resolutions.resolution: Define OAS 1.0 as a coherent eight-domain description and declaration baseline. Include 14 information obligations and defer three operational/evidence-model extensions. Coverage follows required concepts rather than counts. No claim of complete autonomous execution governance.
blocking_question_resolutions.alternatives_considered: A four-domain six-item subset leaves accountability/constraint gaps; including every held operational requirement would pretend unresolved efficacy semantics are solved.

prior_deferred_question_dispositions.resolution: R0–R4 remains informative; no included obligation has risk-conditioned applicability.

The baseline names a responsible party, not verified legal ownership. Additional named parties are allowed; organization name satisfies this description obligation without inventing an organization identity scheme.
A provenance reference must identify the declared version directly or through a version-specific manifest/origin record; no full supply-chain attestation is claimed.
The provider identifies its applicable prohibition policy; explicit empty lists are disclosed policy claims, not safety approval. Control efficacy remains deferred under 0011.
0012 documents the human role/interfaces actually claimed; it does not mandate all intervention kinds or latency guarantees. Operational escalation 0013 is deferred.

Provider-defined lifecycle meaning is interpreted in its referenced documentation, separate from Registry lifecycle. Version/state and retirement responsibility are described; retention/execution rules are deferred.
